Rows tagged v3-A1 are new joints from the v3 joint table in ../DESIGN_LOG.md; coordinates in new flexures / slide rows are the planner's targets and the subsystem work item that builds the joint makes them exact. Renames: post_L/post_R -> PRT_turntable (one print), feeder_housing -> PRT_beam (feed floor + spout integral), feeder_cover -> PRT_feeder_crown (closed lobe), base_partition -> PRT_base_floor, nip_stop -> PRT_launcher_body, nip_stop_sleeve -> PRT_nip_wheel (or PRT_hood). Deleted: groove cap, gate detent clip, post R cover, pan servo clamp, and every FST_ group except FST_adapter (2), FST_pinion_ctr, FST_tilt_horn_ctr, FST_motor, FST_fw_bolt/nut, FST_nip_stud, FST_tw_nut. v2 _about follows: v2 checks. Every geometric v1 review issue has a row here; the id in each 'why' points into ../renders/attempt-N/review.md (A1-#n, A2-#n, A3-Xn). Object names follow DESIGN_LOG.md 'v2 naming'. distances.a/b are exact names. Attempt 2: rows tagged v2-A1-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-1/review.md. PIV_hood values in rows: +1.315 = gap 5.3 (printed min-gap stop, HOOD_HI), -0.558 = gap 7.0 (thumbwheel stop-sleeve static max); keep them in sync with params.solve_eps if NIP_SET changes. Attempt 3: rows tagged v2-A2-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-2/review.md. NEW PIV_hood values: +0.327 = gap 6.2 (HOOD_GAP_MIN raised 5.3 -> 6.2 for A2-01, printed min-gap stop, HOOD_HI), -0.558 = gap 7.0 (static max, unchanged); PIV_nip_lift -1.493 = the leaf stack goes solid against the cover roof (LEAF_PAD_H + LEAF_T = 4.5 between thumbwheel and roof). Nip rays are framed in PIV_hood (A2-04: the PIV_tilt-framed y37 ray slipped past the hood lip at full lift). Attempt 4: rows tagged v2-A3-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-3/review.md. NEW PIV_nip_lift limit -2.190 = leaf solid with LEAF_TRAVEL 2.2 (A3 1.5 -> -1.493); LEAF_T 2.5 -> 2.3, so thumbwheel top to cover roof along the stud axis is 6.5 at rest and LEAF_PAD_H + LEAF_T = 4.3 solid; PIV_hood range unchanged at the static settings (+0.327 = gap 6.2, -0.558 = gap 7.0), HOOD_LO = -2.748. POCKET_D 13.9 -> 13.75 (payload_fit rows). CAB_encoder lead_len is the launcher-side budget of the one-piece 550 encoder lead: 550 - CAB_launcher_bundle - CAB_launcher_base path - 5 spare (params ENC_LEAD, finish.py writes it; about 115 at A3 path lengths). Attempt 5: rows tagged v2-A4-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-4/review.md. PIV_gate is a prismatic joint (0 closed .. 52 open notch, stops -0.4 / 52.35). cable_junctions_ok CAB_bus_* (finish step): the three Hiwonder bus leads (a parallel 3-wire bus) end in one 3-way bus junction on the pan axis at (0, 0, 76), inside the hub bore (BOM item 14a); the CAB_bus_* x CAB_launcher_* pairs there are different conductors drawn to the same axis point. CAB_launcher_bundle -> CAB_launcher_base is one wire per conductor (cable_chains: encoder signal, phase conductors). Attempt 6: rows tagged v2-A5-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-5/review.md. The 3-way bus junction is modelled as BUY_bus_junction (params BUS_JCT: Ø10 x 25 on PIV_pan, centre (5.73, 4.02), z 74..99, az 35 r 7 in the hub bore); CAB_bus_tilt / CAB_bus_feeder end on its top face and CAB_bus_pan 1.2 under its bottom face, so CAB_bus_* are no longer in cable_junctions_ok. The launcher bundle/base meeting point moved off the pan axis to az 235 r 4 at z 70 (-2.29, -3.28, 70), params BUS_LB_JCT. Attempt 7: rows tagged v2-A6-NN close issues from ../renders/attempt-6/review.md. The bus splice and the groove cap move to assembly step 11a (after the feeder is on the beam, pod at tilt 45): every bus lead reaches the turntable groove only after steps 8 / 9 / 11, so the cap that closes the groove and the hub bore goes on last (A6-01). CAB_bus_pan is split at the pan axis into the static U-loop (CAB_bus_pan, step 3) and a PIV_pan tail (CAB_bus_pan_tail, step 11a) ending on the splice's bottom face; cable_chains 'pan bus lead' sums both (A6-02). The swept entry-arc rows start at psi 1 (psi 0 at full lift is past the hood's entry edge at home / max; A6-03).
